description: List the searchable values of one scan beyond its main result: SHA-256 of every response body it loaded, its scripts with their structure and content hashes, script hosts, hosts named in script source, tracking IDs, IDS signatures and more, each with the SMQL filter that finds other scans sharing it. Useful for pivoting from a known phishing page to related ones. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
